items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher gave Bobby Yzaguirre Father Segueira his notice... I only have two more weeks in the band. I sure have enjoyed playing with you.

ctx.x: So (inaudible) nobody said anything-- guys just looked at each other quick. So one night I happened. Fletcher gave Bobby Yzaguirre Father Segueira his notice, and he was a nice guy. So he came over, first of all, to Coleman Hawkins at intermission. He says, "Well, Hawk, I only have two more weeks in the band. I sure have enjoyed playing with you." He says, "I got my notice tonight." Hawk said, "You got your notice? I don't understand Smack." He's talking about my brother. "Why, Smack want to change you?" Man, you…

his book home every night, said, "I just don't understand. I just don't understand this. I can't understand. There you're playing, you're doing so and so. Man, these guys would do, you know?" (Laughter)
